trust_detail: Baseline-v1 verified across 5 scoring tools. E001-fusion evaluated on frozen runs with pre-registered dev/conf protocol.

retrieval_config.bm25: rank_bm25 BM25Okapi k1=1.6 b=0.75, positive IDF, camel/snake splitting, English+code stopwords, title field weight 2.0 (title = doc id on Apps)
retrieval_config.dense: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384-d, normalized, dot product, threshold 0.05, max 256 word-pieces
retrieval_config.official_representation: one vector per document (benchmark/run_mteb.py); windows only in the direct adapter via apps_fixed.npy
retrieval_config.hybrid: RRF k=60, lexical_weight=1.0, semantic_weight=1.0, union of both lists
retrieval_config.reranker: NONE — CROSS_ENCODER_AVAILABLE hardcoded False; 'reranked' aliases hybrid
retrieval_config.tie_break: ASTFLOW: doc id ascending; frozen runs eliminate tie ambiguity
retrieval_config.depth_note: Benchmark ranks with limit=1000 so size=max(500,1000)=1000 per list

bottleneck_detail: E001-fusion proved that RRF parameter shifts cannot recover candidates without diluting top-10 precision. Reranking (E002) is required to reorder top candidates.

experiments.description: Controlled 315-config RRF sweep on dev queries
experiments.reason: Delta on confirmation was negative (-0.00022); 95% bootstrap CI did not exclude zero on either dev or conf.

active_experiment.description: Cross-encoder reranking over top-k (20, 50, 100) hybrid candidates

next_action: Design and execute E002-reranker over frozen candidate lists.
